entities.summary: Iddo Netanyahu is an Israeli physician, author, and playwright. He is the younger brother of Benjamin Netanyahu, the Prime Minister of Israel, and Yonatan Netanyahu who was killed leading the Entebbe raid, a hostage rescue mission in 1976.
